verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is a command-line infrastructure-as-code engine with no graphical UI. A story about matching API capability to UI capability is therefore a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows a UI or a hosted API, and the empty OpenAPI probe confirms there is no web API surface to compare against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
